newsitem.title: SWEDEN: UPS says entering domestic Nordic parcel markets.
newsitem.headline: UPS says entering domestic Nordic parcel markets.

text.p: U.S. express package firm United Parcel Service (UPS) said on Friday it was stepping up its services within Sweden and Denmark to better compete with local postal services and delivery companies.
UPS Sweden AB said it would offer services in Sweden which were faster than those offered by the Swedish Post Office or freight companies such as ASG AB or BTL AB.
"We have not had domestic services within the Nordic region before. UPS is, from the beginning, very much a domestic carrier," UPS Nordic manager Anders Holm told Reuters.
UPS said its 1995 turnover in Sweden was 239 million crowns in 1995. The company employs 270 people in the country.
